east-africa.title: Afrikaa Bahaa
east-africa.description: Keeniyaa, Taanzaaniyaa, Ugaandaa, Itoophiyaa, Ruwaandaa, Buruundii, Somaaliyaa fi Sudaan Kibbaa — Naayiroobii, Daar es Salaam, Finfinnee (Addis Ababa), Kampaalaa, Kigaalii, Mombaasaa, Zaanzibaar, Tulluu Kilimanjaaroo, Serengeetii fi Haroo Viktooriyaa.

horn-of-africa.title: Gaanfa Afrikaa
horn-of-africa.description: Itoophiyaa, Somaaliyaa, Eertiraa, Jibuutii, Sudaan Kibbaa fi kaaba Keeniyaa — Finfinnee (Addis Ababa), Moqaadishoo, Asmaraa, Magaalaa Jibuutii, Juubaa; lafa olka'aa Itoophiyaa, Sulula Qiinxamaa (Rift Valley), qarqara Galaana Diimaa.

south-central-us.title: Giddugala Kibbaa Ameerikaa
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi fi Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson fi Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Saamowaa fi Tongaa
west-polynesia.description: Saamowaa, Saamowaa Ameerikaa, Tongaa, Niuwee, Tokelaawu fi Waalis fi Futuunaa — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi fi Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila fi odoloota Tongaa.

mariana-islands.title: Guwaam fi Odoloota Maariyaanaa Kaabaa
mariana-islands.description: Guwaam fi Odoloota Maariyaanaa Kaabaa — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian fi Rota.

greenland.title: Giriinlaand
greenland.description: Giriinlaand — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq fi Tasiilaq; uwwisa cabbii, Ilulissat Icefjord fi fiyoordota kibbaa.

bermuda.title: Bermuudaa
bermuda.description: Bermuudaa — Hamilton, St. George’s fi Royal Naval Dockyard, aanaalee odolaa fi qarqara galaanaa cirracha diimaa-adiitiin.

belarus.title: Belaruus
belarus.description: Belaruus — Minsk, Gomel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno fi Brest; bosona Belovezhskaya Pushcha fi lafa jajjaboo Polesia.

channel-islands.title: Odoloota Chaanalii
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark fi Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port fi Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Odoloota Faroo
faroe-islands.description: Odoloota Faroo — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík fi odoloota kudha saddeet, gandoota isaanii, boolla karaa fi qarqara kattaa galaanaa.

svalbard.title: Svaalbaard
svalbard.description: Svaalbaard fi Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg fi Ny-Ålesund; cabbii fi fiyoordota Spitsbergen.

malta.title: Maaltaa
malta.description: Maaltaa, Gozo fi Comino — Valletta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria fi Magaalota Sadan.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagaaskaar fi Odoloota Galaana Hindii
madagascar-islands.description: Madagaaskaar, Komoroos, Mayotte, Réunion, Moorishiyes fi Seeshels — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis fi Victoria.

sudan.title: Sudaan
sudan.description: Sudaan — Kaartuum, Omdurmaan, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid fi Nyala; bakka Abbayyaa Cuquliisaa fi Abbayyaa Adiin walitti makaman fi piraamidoota Meroë.

cabo-verde.title: Keep Verdee
cabo-verde.description: Keep Verdee — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria fi odoloota kudhan, Santo Antão irraa hanga Brava.

sao-tome-principe.title: Saawo Toomee fi Prinsiip
sao-tome-principe.description: Saawo Toomee fi Prinsiip — São Tomé, Santo António fi bosona roobaa fi qarqara galaanaa odoloota lamaanii.

saint-helena.title: Saint Helena, Ascension fi Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Saint Helena, Odola Ascension fi Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown fi Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Baangilaadesh
bangladesh.description: Baangilaadesh — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet fi Cox’s Bazar; Sundarbans fi deeltaa Gaanjis–Brahmaputra.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sirii Laankaa fi Maaldiivs
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sirii Laankaa fi Maaldiivs — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura fi Malé; lafa gaaraa, Sigiriya fi atoloota.

vietnam.title: Veetinaam
vietnam.description: Veetinaam — Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An fi Can Tho; Ha Long Bay fi deeltaa Mekong.

philippines.title: Filippiins
philippines.description: Filippiins — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio fi Zamboanga; Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao fi Palawan.

indonesia.title: Indooneeshiyaa fi Tiimor-Lestee
indonesia.description: Indooneeshiyaa fi Tiimor-Lestee — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar fi Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi fi Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Maleeshiyaa, Singaappoor fi Bruunee
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Maleeshiyaa, Singaappoor fi Bruunee — Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching fi Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Miyaanmaar
myanmar.description: Miyaanmaar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine fi Haroo Inle; sulula Irrawaddy fi tulluuwwan Shan.

cambodia-laos.title: Kamboodiyaa fi Laa’os
cambodia-laos.description: Kamboodiyaa fi Laa’os — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap fi Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang fi Pakse; Mekong fi Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Kolombiyaa
colombia.description: Kolombiyaa — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena fi Bucaramanga; Andes, qarqara Kariibiyaanii fi Amazon.

venezuela.title: Veenzuweelaa
venezuela.description: Veenzuweelaa — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida fi Ciudad Bolívar; Angel Falls, Orinoco fi Isla Margarita.

peru.title: Peeruu
peru.description: Peeruu — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos fi Puno; Machu Picchu, Haroo Titicaca fi Sulula Qulqulluu.

ecuador.title: Ikuwaadoor
ecuador.description: Ikuwaadoor — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta fi Baños; Avenue of the Volcanoes, Amazon fi Odoloota Galápagos.

bolivia.title: Booliiviyaa
bolivia.description: Booliiviyaa — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre fi Potosí; Haroo Titicaca fi Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Chiilee
chile.description: Chiilee — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena fi Punta Arenas; Atacama, Naannoo Harootaa, Patagonia fi Odola Easter.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paaraaguwaay fi Uruguwaay
paraguay-uruguay.description: Paaraaguwaay fi Uruguwaay — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este fi Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: Giyaanota
guianas.description: Guyaanaa, Surinaam fi Giyaanaa Faransaa — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Cayenne fi Kourou; Kaieteur Falls fi bosona roobaa Guiana Shield.

falklands.title: Odoloota Fooklaand
falklands.description: Odoloota Fooklaand — Stanley, Goose Green fi odoloota East Falkland fi West Falkland.

australia.title: Awustiraaliyaa
australia.description: Awustiraaliyaa — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin fi Canberra; Great Barrier Reef, Uluru fi Outback.

new-zealand.title: Niw Zilaand
new-zealand.description: Niw Zilaand — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin fi Queenstown; Southern Alps, Fiordland fi Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: British Columbia
british-columbia.description: British Columbia — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George fi Whistler; Coast Mountains, Odola Vancouver fi Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Dirree Kanaadaa
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan fi Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina fi Banff; Rockies, dirree fi Churchill qarqara Hudson Bay.

ontario.title: Ontaariyoo
ontario.description: Ontaariyoo — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston fi Thunder Bay; Niagara Falls, Haroowwan Gurguddoo fi Algonquin Park.

quebec.title: Kuwebek
quebec.description: Kuwebek — Montréal, Quebec City, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke fi Saguenay; St. Lawrence, Laurentians fi Gaspé Peninsula.

atlantic-canada.title: Kanaadaa Atlaantikii
atlantic-canada.description: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, fi Newfoundland fi Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton fi Charlottetown; Cabot Trail fi Bay of Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Kaaba Kanaadaa
northern-canada.description: Yukon, Northwest Territories fi Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City fi Inuvik; Arctic Archipelago fi Laga Mackenzie.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Koong fi Makaawoo
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Koong fi Makaawoo — Odola Hong Kong, Kowloon, New Territories, Lantau fi Macau Peninsula, Taipa fi Coloane.

antarctica.title: Antaarktikaa
antarctica.description: Antaarktikaa — McMurdo Station, Scott Base fi Villa Las Estrellas; Antarctic Peninsula, odoloota South Shetland, Ross Ice Shelf fi Gaara Erebus. Kaartaan kun 85° kibbaatti dhuma, South Pole hin ga'u.
